name: QGO Finance Limited
about: QGO Finance Limited, a non-banking financial company, provides financial services in India. The company offers project loans, loans against property, business loans, and co-operative housing society loans. It also provides business analysis, financial consult, and project reporting services. The company was formerly known as Parnami Credits Limited. QGO Finance Limited was incorporated in 1993 and is headquartered in Navi Mumbai, India.
